branches.name: Saute & Mee
branches.notes: Address reproduces merchant website and Oddle wording, both of which omit a complete street name. The independent directory lead says 339 Anchorvale Road; do not silently treat that secondary street correction as merchant-confirmed. Unit, mall, postal code and the single linked ordering outlet agree.

menus.name: Saute & Mee official online food menu
menus.notice: All accessible food products, variants and food modifiers in the public Oddle catalogue are captured. Delivery/pickup prices are not asserted to be dine-in prices. Drinks and drink bundles are excluded. Checked date is retrieval date, not an effective menu date. Merchant dietary labels in names/options are factual labels, not independent ingredient certification.

menus.name: Saute & Mee website dish gallery
menus.notice: All accessible named prepared-food gallery cards are captured, deduplicating repeated placements of the same name and code. Website does not publish prices for these cards. The linked ordering catalogue differs and is recorded separately; no price is transferred between channels. Five visually inspected lunch/student posters all include drinks and are excluded. Website content has no menu effective date and includes some historical labels; current stock/availability is not inferred. Ingredient health cards and beverages are omitted.
